intro.en: Adjectives have three degrees: positive (tall), comparative (taller — comparing two) and superlative (tallest — comparing three or more).
intro.hi: विशेषण की तीन अवस्थाएँ हैं: positive (tall), comparative (taller — दो की तुलना) और superlative (tallest — तीन या ज़्यादा की तुलना)।
